title: Yellowed Nutty Polish Pork Casserole
description: A comforting Polish dish featuring ground allspice, with a nutty and gooey texture, cooked in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware style, but using a bamboo tray for a modern twist, and incorporating anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the ground pork, ground allspice, turmeric, and ginger, and cook until the pork is browned.
In a separate pot, bring the chicken broth to a boil.
Add the brown rice to the pot and cook according to the package instructions.
In a large bamboo tray, combine the cooked pork mixture, cooked rice, and chopped walnuts.
Transfer the tray to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the tray from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
